title: 297. Triangle

examples.explanation: One cheapest route is 2 -> 3 -> 5 -> 1, which sums to 11.
A single row forces that value.

hints: Work bottom-up: each cell adds its value to the smaller of its two children.
You can reuse the bottom row as the DP array for O(n) extra space.
A top-down memo on (row, index) also works.
